title: Senior Dokumentenmanager
description:

Wir unterstützen internationale Kunden bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Qualitätssicherung komplexer Energieprojekte und arbeiten dabei mit führenden Unternehmen der Branche zusammen.

Als Senior Dokumentenmanager (m/w/d) sind Sie verantwortlich für die Planung, Umsetzung und Kontrolle eines projektspezifischen, bedarfsgerechten Dokumentenmanagements (DMG) über den gesamten Dokumentenlebenszyklus hinweg – von der Erstellung über Freigabe, Verteilung, Ablage und Archivierung bis hin zur finalen Übergabe.

Sie agieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Projektleitung, PMO, internen Fachabteilungen und externen Partnern und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Sicherstellung der Dokumentationsqualität sowie zur effizienten Projektkommunikation.

 

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Einrichtung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung eines projektspezifischen Dokumentenmanagementsystems (z. B. Aconex, SharePoint, ThinkProject)

  • Analyse von Rahmenbedingungen, Anforderungen, internen und externen Schnittstellen sowie Richtlinien

  • Konzeption von Prozessen zur Erstellung, Prüfung, Freigabe, Verteilung und Archivierung von Dokumenten

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektleitung, Fachbereichen und Qualitätssicherung

  • Definition und Dokumentation von Rollen, Tools, Vorlagen sowie Struktur- und Ablagelogiken

  • Erstellung von Vorlagen, DMG-Richtlinien, Projektanleitungen und Berichten

  • Schulung der Projektteams (z. B. Präsentationen, How-to-Guides)

  • Qualitätskontrolle ein- und ausgehender Dokumente sowie Nachverfolgung von Fristen und Workflows

  • Administration des Dokumentenmanagementsystems (Benutzerverwaltung, Rechtevergabe, Systempflege)

  • Koordination der As-built-Dokumentation und Übergabe an das Unternehmensarchiv

  • Schnittstellenmanagement mit externen Partnern (z. B. Lieferanten)

  • Sicherstellung von Compliance und normgerechter Dokumentation (z. B. ISO 9001)

 

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Dokumentenmanagement, Informationstechnik oder vergleichbar

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in großen Infrastruktur- oder Industrieprojekten

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Einführung und Anwendung gängiger DMG-Systeme und virtueller Projekträume

  • Sehr gutes Organisationsvermögen sowie strukturiertes Denken

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Teamorientierung

  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein im Umgang mit sensiblen Informationen

 

Was wir bieten

title: Remote Maintenance Engineer
description:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Customer Success Associate - Renewable Energy
description:
Customer Success Associate – Renewable Energy

Festanstellung · Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Customer-Success-Teams.

trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industrieunternehmen mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit unserem integrierten Ansatz aus Energieversorgung, moderner Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligenter Optimierung des Energieverbrauchs helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen.

Als Customer Success Associate unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen dabei, den vollen Mehrwert aus unserem nachhaltigen Produktportfolio zu ziehen. Du sorgst für eine reibungslose Betreuung, koordinierst wichtige Prozesse und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich mit trawa arbeiten.


Das Team

Unser Customer Success Team begleitet Kund:innen von der ersten Anfrage bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft – mit dem Ziel, echten Mehrwert zu liefern, Wachstum im Bestand zu treiben und exzellenten Service zu skalieren. Wir stehen unseren Kund:innen nicht nur operativ zur Seite, sondern beraten sie auch aktiv zu Fragen rund um den Energiemarkt – damit sie in einem komplexen, volatilen Umfeld die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen können. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Product und Operations zusammen und bist mittendrin, wenn es darum geht, wie trawa seine Kund:innen langfristig erfolgreich macht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust unsere Kund:innen persönlich und sorgst dafür, dass sie langfristig zufrieden und erfolgreich mit unseren Produkten arbeiten.

  • Onboarding begleiten: Du unterstützt neue Kund:innen bei ihrem Einstieg in das trawa-Universum, koordinierst den Onboarding-Prozess und begleitest die Einführung unserer Softwarelösungen. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass alle benötigten Informationen vorliegen und die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen eingebunden sind.

  • Teamübergreifend arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unseren Kolleg:innen aus Product und Sales gestaltest du eine Customer Experience, die unsere Kund:innen begeistert.

  • Kundenanfragen bearbeiten: Du bearbeitest und priorisierst eingehende Kundenanfragen, löst Probleme zeitnah und eigenständig oder leitest sie strukturiert an die zuständige Customer Success Managerin weiter.

  • Datenqualität sicherstellen: Du pflegst Kundendaten in unseren Systemen, zum Beispiel im CRM, und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

  • Reports und QBRs vorbereiten: Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung interner Meetings, Kunden-QBRs und relevanter Reportings.

Nach wem wir suchen

Dein Hintergrund

  • Du hast ein Studium in einem relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit guten Leistungen abgeschlossen.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Betreuung von B2B-Kund:innen, in analytischen Tätigkeiten oder in koordinativen Rollen sind von Vorteil.

Deine Fähigkeiten

  • Du bist ein Organisationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren.

  • Du verfügst über exzellente kommunikative Fähigkeiten und gehst professionell sowie serviceorientiert auf Kund:innen zu – schriftlich und mündlich.

  • Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich im Umgang mit Zahlen wohl und kannst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher und verständlich kommunizieren.

Dein technisches Verständnis

  • Du bist technologieaffin. CRM-Systeme und digitale Tools sind für dich keine Hürde, sondern eine spannende Herausforderung.

  • Erste Erfahrungen in der Energiebranche sind ein Plus. Idealerweise interessierst du dich für erneuerbare Energien und möchtest dich in diesem Bereich weiterentwickeln.

Deine Sprachkenntnisse

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau.

  • Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Weitere europäische Sprachen sind von Vorteil.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Monat 1: Einarbeitung und Orientierung

  • Du lernst trawas Produkte, Prozesse und den Energiemarkt kennen.

  • Du verstehst, wie Kundenbeziehungen bei trawa funktionieren – vom Onboarding bis zum QBR.

  • Du baust erste Beziehungen zu Kund:innen und internen Stakeholdern auf.

  • Du wirst von erfahrenen Customer Success Manager:innen begleitet und übernimmst erste eigene Aufgaben in der Kundenbetreuung.

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig erste Kundenaccounts und wirst zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson für operative Stakeholder.

Monat 3 und danach: Eigenständige Kundenbetreuung

  • Du erkennst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Kund:innen noch besser betreuen und ihre Erfahrungen mit trawa weiter verbessern können.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kund:innen und die Umwelt haben.

  • Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte und Kundenerlebnisse, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstands beitragen. Dein Beitrag hat direkten Einfluss, und du kannst stolz auf deine Ergebnisse sein.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Büro fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur, in der wir gerne gemeinsam arbeiten. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls möglich. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und bis zu zehn Workation-Tagen unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du wirst Teil eines tollen Teams, in dem Coaching und Mentoring großgeschrieben werden. Außerdem arbeitest du mit modernen Technologien und lernst von erfahrenen Expert:innen aus der Branche.

  • Vielfalt und Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen. Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven Arbeitsplatz ein, der Vielfalt wertschätzt, und ermutigen Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft sowie körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen. Wir entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen. We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

The team

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.


Responsibilites

  • Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

  • Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

  • Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.


    • Requirements

  • 5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

  • Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

  • You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL.

  • It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).


    • What we're looking for

  • You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

title: Softwarearchitekt (x) Energiemarkt
description:

Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst.

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.

  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur.
  • Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen.
  • Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein.
  • Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse.
  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
  • Ein Team mit Ambition
    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
  • Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise
    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.

    Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

  • Darüber hinaus: Kreativität, Eigeninitiative, eine gewissenhafte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägter Teamgeist
  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle und vielseitige Aufgabe in einer dynamischen, gemeinnützigen Stiftung
  • Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Ausgeprägter Team- und Netzwerkgedanke 
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding 
  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen durch die Möglichkeit zur Mitnutzung eines Restaurants, hybrides Arbeiten, Deutschlandticket, Lern-, Sport- und Gesundheitsangeboten, Kulturveranstaltungen und vieles mehr

What to Expect

Caspar Health is entering its next growth phase. Our digital care is becoming increasingly critical to clinic and hospital operations. At the same time, we are progressing towards medical-device obligations and expanding AI-enabled ways of working.

As CTO, you will own Technology and Engineering at C-level. You will report to the CEO, lead Engineering with full functional and disciplinary responsibility and work as a peer to the CPO.

Your job is not to become the bottleneck or Caspar's most important individual technologist. You will build a strong leadership layer and an Engineering system that moves quickly with security, resilience and evidence. You will stay close enough to technology to judge important decisions, risks and AI-enabled development through current practice.


This position is based in Germany and must be performed, living in Germany. Due to our current payroll and social security arrangements, we cannot offer permanent employment from abroad. Applicants must therefore be able to perform their duties from Germany starting on their first day of work and must already have the necessary authorization to work in Germany.


Your Challenges

  • Translate company and product strategy into a technology strategy with clear capabilities, investments, risks and measurable 18-month proof points.

  • Lead all Engineering teams and Engineering leads, including Platform, Infrastructure, DevOps/SRE, developer experience and Engineering-owned quality automation.

  • Build a strong leadership layer, clear domain ownership, distributed knowledge and resilient internal and external capacity without single-person dependencies.

  • Own architecture, technology choices, reliability, security implementation, technical evidence and reporting, and regulated development for critical clinic and hospital workflows. Keep Caspar ready for deep technical scrutiny with current architecture and ownership evidence, demonstrable Caspar IP ownership, auditable security and compliance evidence, a credible AI story and no critical single-person dependencies.

  • Own the incident system and lead major or trust-critical escalations. You are not the standing first-line on-call engineer. Ensure postmortem actions are completed and verified.

  • Plan the Engineering budget and capacity. Decide within the approved envelope on technology, vendors and build, buy or outsource options, including lifecycle cost and continuity.

  • Shape AI-enabled Engineering through current personal practice. Create measurable leverage without weakening security, maintainability, review quality, traceability or regulated assurance.

  • Make credible commitments with Product. Product owns outcomes and scope intent. You own technical feasibility, capacity and release readiness, and stop unsupported or unsafe commitments.

  • Involve Medical, Quality, Information Security, Privacy and Legal early. Engineering turns requirements into reusable controls, tests and evidence. Independent functions retain review, stop and risk-acceptance rights.

  • Establish clear data contracts with Data. Technology owns production and operational data systems. Data owns semantics, certified analytical datasets, metric governance, analytical quality, experimentation and decision science.

  • Represent Caspar in high-stakes technical discussions with clinics, hospital IT, integration partners, auditors, investors and the board.


What success looks like

In your first year, you will:


  • Build a strong Engineering leadership layer and accountable ownership for critical systems

  • Connect technology choices and investment to company strategy and reviewable proof points, then complete a deep external technical review at customer, auditor or investor standard with no unresolved material findings

  • Improve delivery predictability, release quality, resilience and regulated evidence

  • Make cooperation between Engineering, Infrastructure and independent Security durable and effective

  • Create measurable impact through AI-enabled Engineering without weakening security or quality

  • You have managed multiple Engineering leaders and led a multi-team organization through a meaningful scale or rigor transition.

  • You have owned technology strategy, budget, capacity and build, buy or outsource decisions at executive level, with evidence of their impact.

  • You have led Engineering in regulated, security-critical or high-availability systems. Medical-device or digital-health experience is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • You have built and scaled cloud-SaaS products, ideally in a regulated environment. Health-tech or medical-device experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. You also bring broad systems depth across backend services, web and mobile clients, APIs and integrations, data flows, observability, security and operations. Our exact stack is not a hard filter.

  • You currently work hands-on with agentic development workflows and can show how you used, constrained or rejected AI output and made it scale

  • You have shipped products that achieved meaningful customer and business outcomes and bring product judgement and pace, not only engineering rigor. You can challenge Product constructively, make business and technical trade-offs explicit and protect credible commitments under pressure.

  • You build trust with teams, customers, partners, auditors, investors and boards without acting as a rescuer or creating dependence on yourself.

  • You are business-fluent in German and English.


A university degree or fixed number of years is not required. We care about demonstrated impact, judgement and responsibility you have personally carried.


Why Caspar Health?

  • A genuine C-level mandate with ownership of Engineering and company technology strategy.

  • The opportunity to combine speed and rigor for digital clinical workflows and make a tangible difference to care.

  • A clear Product-Technology peer model with shared decisions instead of hidden hand-offs.

Deine Aufgaben

Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the EA role at Trainline 👋

We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to be a true right-hand partner to our Chief Product Officer and 3 cross functional VPs - bringing calm, clarity and momentum to a demanding, globally connected schedule. You’ll manage agendas end-to-end (prep, logistics, comms, attendees), act as a gatekeeper for leadership time, and help run key meeting cadences including planning, QBRs, reviews and offsites. The role is hybrid and requires regular in-office presence to support leaders and collaborate seamlessly with other EAs and cross-functional stakeholders.

As an EA at Trainline, you will... 🚄

  • Agenda management; keep ahead of potential scheduling conflicts; using initiative to find solutions and communicate changes in a timely manner

  • Act as a gatekeeper for leaders’ time, balancing strategic priorities with operational realities

  • Inbox management and correspondence

  • Support leadership rhythms such as planning cycles, QBRs, reviews and offsites

  • Travel management including flights, trains, taxis, arranging visas and accommodation

  • Event planning both in-house and offsite

  • Project support as required

  • Support for new staff

  • Expense management and reporting

  • Work cross-functionally with a wide variety of teams

  • Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and sound judgment
    Build strong relationships with other EAs and stakeholders to coordinate seamlessly at pace

  • Experience supporting at Director/C-Suite level

  • Accustomed to the demands of multiple Executives requiring conflicting changes simultaneously.

  • Able to work under pressure to strict deadlines and manage workload effectively under very demanding conditions.

  • Able to build strong relationships across the business with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Strong prioritisation skills and sound judgement

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ensure our product security practices align with relevant frameworks and standards, such as OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR and PCI DSS, supporting compliance and audit efforts while monitoring emerging threats and finding ways to strengthen our resilience

  • Experience securing mobile applications and APIs, including testing iOS and Android apps and applying secure approaches to authentication and authorisation, such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect

  • Hands-on experience with security testing tools such as SAST, DAST and vulnerability scanning solutions, ideally including mobile app security testing and API security testing tools

  • Practical experience with threat modelling and security reviews, as well as scoping and managing third-party penetration tests in partnership with engineering teams and architects

  • A strong grasp of secure coding practices and experience embedding security into software development workflows, including implementing technical controls and driving automation within CI/CD pipelines, ideally across cloud-native, containerised and infrastructure as code (IaC) environments

  • Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP (ideally including the Mobile Application Security Verification Standard and API Security Top 10), PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and GDPR

  • It would also be helpful if you have experience setting up or growing a security champions programme, running risk assessments, or a working knowledge of regulatory compliance standards

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Safety)
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions.

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all.

About the role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

You will lead the bridge between AI research and real-world impact by architecting scalable, production-grade machine learning systems. Partnering directly with clients and cross-functional teams, you will drive technical strategy, mentor teams on best practices, and collaborate with Frontier Labs to define and reinforce our industry leadership in practical, high-stakes AI safety.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML systems and capability testing of Frontier AI models

  • Designing and building production-grade ML software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You have significant experience building and deploying secure and scalable LLM applications, and are comfortable with multi-agent harness tooling and AI Safety evaluation procedures.

  • You understand the full ML lifecycle and are confident operationalising models built with frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) specifically cloud architecture, infrastructure management, and end-to-end cybersecurity practices

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

 

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

A Senior Full-Stack Engineer who owns new features end-to-end: the React interface a clinician clicks, the Python service behind it, and the data model underneath. You have shipped SaaS products inside a high-growth startup, and a slow query bothers you as much as a component that drops frames.

You know where the trade-offs live on both sides of the stack: when logic belongs in the browser and when it belongs on the server, and how a schema decision made today shows up as latency on screen in six months.

You take a loose brief and return a working, tested feature without waiting for a hand-off from another team. You read the user need behind the ticket.

You thrive in a flat, flexible team, and you pick up the specifics of building an AI product for clinicians in 190+ countries within your first weeks.

Brilliant people come from unlikely places. If you have a record of shipping hard, technically demanding products and features, whatever the industry, we want to meet you.

What you'll do

You will work alongside the engineers who built Heidi, shipping AI products that change how healthcare runs.

  • Own features from database to browser: design the data model, build the Python service, ship the React and TypeScript interface, then watch how clinicians use it and iterate.

  • Build fast, accessible interfaces in React, TypeScript and Next.js that hold up for a GP seeing twenty patients before lunch.

  • Design, build and run high-performance backend services in Python, with MongoDB and Redis for storage and caching.

  • Design APIs the rest of engineering and the AI team build on, and own their versioning, documentation, testing and security.

  • Develop and manage message queue systems for real-time data processing.

  • Shape the cloud infrastructure your features run on so they scale and stay up.

  • Pair with product, design and AI engineers to turn a brief into a shipped workflow, then measure and go again.

  • Write code your colleagues can read, test and extend six months from now.

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production work on both the frontend and the backend.

  • Strong React and TypeScript, plus Next.js or a comparable framework. You know the browser: rendering performance, state management, accessibility.

  • Python in production: building, testing and running backend services.

  • Hands-on MongoDB and Redis, with sound judgment on data modeling, design patterns and trade-offs.

  • Experience building and managing message queue systems at scale.

  • Deep understanding of API design: security, versioning, performance and the contract between client and server.

  • Application and data security knowledge on both sides of that contract.

  • Experience integrating with third-party systems.

  • Testable, communicative code, and fluency with source control and CI/CD pipelines.

  • A record of building systems that scale, stay up under load and hold up to security scrutiny.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai. For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API, and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

 

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

 

What you'd be doing

  • Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

  • Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

  • Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

  • Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

  • Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

  • Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

 

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

 

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

 

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

  • Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

  • Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

  • Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

  • Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

  • Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have

  • Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

  • Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

  • Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.

  • Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

  • Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

 

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

 

How we hire

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

 

Practicalities

Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.

Demonstration Preparation

  • Monitor the condition of the demonstration fleet and report anomalies

Administrative Support

  • Prepare authorisation requests and write mission reports

  • Keep tracking tools up to date: backlog, planning, and mission logs


Candidate Profile

  • Good physical condition — outdoor work and load carrying are part of the role

  • Experience in drone piloting or the UAS/C-UAS ecosystem is a plus

  • Experience shipping sensitive equipment is a plus

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is the operating system of the future for Utilities. When a utility signs up to use Kraken, they have some big ambitions. They want to; improve customer experience, reduce cost to serve or accelerate growth and innovation. To make this possible at pace, clients need the incredible tech stack that Kraken offers, the ability to improve how they operate and to have a culture that enables them to thrive. 

Clients are increasingly interested in understanding how they can improve not only their customer operations but the business functions, and business units that sit horizontally and vertically to customer operations in retail. 

To enable this Kraken now structures itself across 3 key delivery practice groups. Human Design, Org Design and Tech. 

This role sits within the Human Design Team. 

Purpose of the Human Design Lead

The main purpose of the Human Design Lead is to be the single point of accountability for the successful enablement and implementation of culture / ways of working transformation in our clients. Human Design activities align to Global Practices and include:

  • Human enablement

  • Behavioural transformation

  • Leadership Development Programs

  • Coaching

      1. Line of Sight

      3. Exec LDP

    • Lead top-down cultural transformation, working with the C-suite and exec layer in organisations

    • Senior cover for Human Design activities throughout migration including ongoing risk monitoring and escalation

  • Cultural stewardship

    • Embody the Kraken ways of working and support the delivery team to do the same (and ensure a consistent experience across the portfolio)

    • Act as the bridge between new clients and best practice success stories

🧠 What you bring to the party:

  • In depth knowledge and expertise in all facets of Human Design necessary to enable transformation (including cultural transformation, leadership development, coaching, learning) 

  • Experience in leading portfolios of major program transformations across different geographies

  • Track record of trust-based partnerships with C-suite and executives

  • Excellent communication skills at storytelling level across different seniorities and cultures

  • Excellent facilitation skills

  • Experience in navigating ambiguity and complexity 

  • Clear understanding of the connection between human, organisation and technology in the context of tech-enabled transformations 

  • Experience of working within the Energy, Utilities and Telco industries is highly desirable 

  • In depth knowledge of leadership and organisation behavioral best practices including concepts such as 

    • Psychological safety

    • Empowerment 

    • Growth mindset 

    • Agile leadership 

    • High performing team

What we’re looking for

  • A systems thinker who is human-led based in Paris, France 

  • We are a kind, friendly, human organisation.

  • Deep understanding of adult learning, behaviour change and organisational psychology.

  • A world-class and experienced leadership development expert.

  • A storyteller who deeply understands the art of facilitation 

  • Proven credibility working with senior leaders and executives.

  • Experience building or scaling leadership or learning practices in complex environments.

Project Management:

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

Experience

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

  • Analyser les enjeux de sécurité, de vie privée et d’éthique liés au déploiement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle (IA) dans des domaines critiques et variés, notamment la santé, la finance et les transports.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’apprentissage automatique préservant la vie privée (Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning – PPML) et leur capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires et éthiques, notamment celles découlant du RGPD et de l’AI Act.

  • Concevoir et évaluer des approches de protection de la vie privée dans des environnements d’apprentissage décentralisé, en particulier dans le cadre de l’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Identifier et caractériser les vulnérabilités de sécurité propres à l’apprentissage collaboratif et fédéré, notamment les attaques par empoisonnement de données, l’injection de portes dérobées (backdoors) et les attaques visant la confidentialité des données et des utilisateurs.

  • Étudier les mécanismes d’inférence à partir des mises à jour de modèles, notamment les attaques par inférence d’appartenance et par inférence de propriétés, afin d’évaluer les risques de divulgation d’informations sensibles.

  • Évaluer la robustesse et la confidentialité des modèles d’IA dans des contextes où les données, les nœuds et les processus d’apprentissage sont distribués et difficilement auditables.

  • Étudier les méthodes d’intelligence artificielle explicable (XAI) afin d’améliorer la transparence, l’interprétabilité et la compréhension des décisions produites par les modèles d’IA.

  • Analyser les interactions et compromis entre explicabilité, vie privée et robustesse dans les systèmes d’apprentissage décentralisé.

  • Développer et expérimenter des méthodes permettant de concilier transparence et protection de la vie privée, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements distribués.

  • Mettre en place des protocoles expérimentaux et des critères d’évaluation permettant de mesurer les niveaux de confidentialité, de robustesse et d’explicabilité des approches étudiées.

  • Contribuer à la valorisation et à la diffusion des résultats de recherche, notamment par la rédaction de publications scientifiques, la présentation des travaux dans des conférences et la participation aux échanges avec les partenaires du projet.

  • Assurer une veille scientifique et technologique sur les avancées en IA de confiance,

Activités

  • Concevoir et développer des mécanismes d’apprentissage décentralisé offrant de fortes garanties de confidentialité, une résistance aux comportements malveillants et des capacités d’explicabilité pertinentes.

  • Étudier la confidentialité des mécanismes d’explicabilité, en particulier les risques de fuite d’informations susceptibles d’être induits par les méthodes d’explicabilité appliquées aux modèles d’apprentissage fédéré.

  • Développer de nouvelles stratégies d’attaque et d’évaluation permettant de caractériser les informations susceptibles d’être divulguées par les mécanismes d’explicabilité.

  • Concevoir des mécanismes de protection adaptés permettant de limiter les fuites d’informations identifiées tout en préservant la qualité et la pertinence des explications produites.

  • Développer des approches d’apprentissage collaboratif conciliant confidentialité et explicabilité, en tenant compte des contraintes propres aux environnements fédérés et décentralisés.

  • Étudier l’utilisation de la confidentialité différentielle (Differential Privacy – DP) pour protéger les modèles agrégés contre les attaques par inférence et analyser son impact sur la qualité et la fidélité des explications.

  • Explorer des primitives cryptographiques adaptées à l’apprentissage fédéré, notamment le chiffrement partiellement ou totalement homomorphe et les techniques de calcul multipartite sécurisé (Secure Multi-Party Computation – MPC).

  • Combiner les mécanismes cryptographiques et la confidentialité différentielle afin d’explorer des compromis entre niveau de confidentialité, qualité des explications, coût de calcul et éventuelles fuites d’information.

Vos missions :

  • Représenter l'Assurance Qualité au sein des équipes projets et garantir l'application des politiques de qualification pour les nouveaux équipements.

  • Rédiger et revoir la documentation de qualification : FAT, SAT, QI, QO, QE et QP, selon les besoins des projets.
  • Participer à l'exécution des qualifications sur le terrain, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Utilisateurs et Ingénierie.

  • Participer aux réunions de suivi des projets et assurer la représentation de l'Assurance Qualité auprès des différentes parties prenantes.
  • Veiller au respect des plannings de qualification et assurer le suivi des activités Qualité associées aux projets.
  • Contribuer aux démarches réglementaires nécessaires dans le cadre des modifications apportées aux installations.

Requirements

  • Formation : Formation Ingénieur, Pharmacien ou niveau scientifique/technique équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, autonomie, organisation, capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse, aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe projet.
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel niveau B2 minimum, permettant de rédiger de la documentation GMP en anglais et de participer à des réunions ou échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

Benefits

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse qui offre à ses collaborateurs l'opportunité d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, permet à nos collaborateurs de développer leurs expertises aux côtés d'acteurs majeurs des Life Sciences.

title: Gestionnaire financier et budgétaire, en charge des recettes
description:
L’environnement :

 

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

 

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Au sein de la Direction générale des services (DGS), la Division des Affaires Financières (DAF) est constituée de 3 pôles d’activités : le pôle recettes & opérations fléchées, le pôle dépenses et pôle comptabilité des matériels. Elle regroupe 11 agents répartis sur les sites de Brest et Palaiseau. Elle est placée sous l’autorité d’un responsable de division, qui est secondé par un adjoint, également chef du pôle dépenses. Le pôle recettes, que vous rejoindrez, est constitué d’une cheffe de pôle, basée sur le campus Paris-Saclay, et de 3 gestionnaires budgétaire et financier en charges des recettes.

La/le titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du pôle Recettes & opérations fléchées, sur le Campus de Paris-Saclay.

Vos missions / Activités principales :

 

Sous l’autorité hiérarchique de la cheffe du pôle Recettes & opérations fléchées, le/la gestionnaire en charge des recettes est chargé-e de :

  • Réceptionner et prioriser les demandes de recettes effectuées par les différents services ;

  • Vérifier la qualité des pièces justificatives du titre de recette et s’assurer de leur bonne réception, en assistant les services prescripteurs le cas échéant ;

  • Aide à la mise en place d’un outil de pilotage des recettes globalisées conjointement avec les différents services métiers concernés ;

  • Saisir l’ensemble des données relatives aux conventions et contrats de recettes dans le module dédié du SI Finance conformément au référentiel analytique et budgétaire de l’établissement ;

  • Contrôler la fiabilité des informations reportées dans les états et outils de restitution ;

  • Réaliser les rapports financiers intermédiaires et finaux des contrats de recherche.

  • Veiller à la coordination des opérations avec le service de l’agence comptable pour garantir le rapprochement des recettes de l’établissement et leur régularisation ;

  • Veiller à la bonne diffusion des informations pratiques sur les procédures administratives liées au processus recette et participer à leur amélioration et suivre les dossiers et relancer les interlocuteurs internes ou externes concernés ;

  • Participer au suivi budgétaire des produits en veillant à la bonne réception des pièces émanant des différents services et en suivant les taux d’exécution.

Missions / Activité annexe :

 

  • Participer aux opérations d’inventaire en matière de recettes (produits à recevoir, produits constatés d’avance…) en relation avec les services métiers et l’agence comptable, dans le cadre de la clôture annuelle ;

  • Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités.

 

La/le titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du pôle Recettes & opérations fléchées, sur le Campus de Paris-Saclay. Il/elle sera amené à travailler régulièrement avec les membres du pôle du campus de Brest. 

Niveau de diplôme et formations :

BAC à BAC + 2

Emploi :

Postes ouverts aux candidats :

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie C+ / B ;

  • Agent contractuel (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 18 mois de CDD.

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : emploi pérenne

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

 

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes »

Poste à temps complet (39h hebdomadaires, 25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels).

 

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %) ;

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an) ;

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande) ;

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement ;

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay) ;

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement).

 

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

Modalités de candidature :

Pour tout renseignement sur le poste, contacter Vanessa MICHAUD, cheffe du pôle recettes & opérations fléchées :

Présentation de l’école :

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Profil attendu :

Connaissances :

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche ;

  • Gestion budgétaire et comptable publique (GBCP) ;

  • Fondamentaux de la maitrise des risques et du contrôle internes.

 

Savoir-faire :

  • Maîtrise des systèmes d’information financière et des technologies numériques associées ;

  • Maîtrise des outils bureautique (pack office) ;

  • Réaliser des analyses financières, suivre des indicateurs et tenir des tableaux de bord ;

  • Travailler en réseau.

 

Savoir être :

  • Sens de la pédagogie et de la communication, très bon relationnel ;

  • Sens des responsabilités et savoir faire preuve de réserve et de discrétion professionnelle ;

  • Être autonome et capable d’initiative, tout en sachant rendre compte de son action ;

  • Rigueur et organisation, respect des délais et des priorités tout en étant capable d’adaptation et de réactivité.

title: Controller
description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

  • Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure

Benefits

Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record.

Apply Today!

If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. Notabene considers a broad array of candidates, including those without blockchain experience. Whether you're returning to work after a gap in employment, or taking the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar.

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

  • Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

  • Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

  • Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

  • Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

  • Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

  • Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

  • Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

  • Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

  • A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.
