description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany, Austria, or Switzerland.

  • Provide accounting and treasury input into selected business initiatives, new products and operational changes.

  • Experience working in an international, multi-entity organisation.

  • A strong understanding of accounting processes, internal controls, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience making finance operations more reliable, structured, documented or scalable.

  • Experience with ERP systems; NetSuite experience would be a plus.

  • A pragmatic approach to technology and automation: you understand where tooling can create leverage and where strong process foundations are required first.

  • Confident communication with senior stakeholders, auditors, banks, advisors and cross-functional partners.

  • A structured and calm leadership style, particularly during close, audits and periods of organisational change.

  • Strong ownership, sound judgement and the ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Why this role

This is an opportunity to lead and strengthen the accounting and treasury backbone of a growing, international fintech.

You will join an experienced team with established systems while still having meaningful scope to improve processes, controls, collaboration and ways of working.

Rather than owning every Finance function, you will have a focused mandate: building reliable and scalable Finance Operations that support Taxfix’s next stage of growth.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other.   • Platform: Build the interface for Kosmos, the platform that brings together enterprise data, operational context and AI

We care more about evidence of cleverness, craft and learning speed than about years of experience, credentials or prior use of our exact stack.

Nice to Have

  • TypeScript, React or Next.js

  • Design systems, component libraries or Storybook

  • Visual regression, accessibility and browser testing

  • SDKs, developer platforms, embedded applications or microfrontends

  • Complex interfaces involving data grids, graphs, editors, workflows or real-time state

  • Experience designing tools or interfaces for AI-assisted development

Our current stack includes Next.js 16.3, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Radix-based components, TanStack libraries, Storybook, Vitest and Playwright. Familiarity helps, but none of these tools is a prerequisite.

  • A cooperative team where you own your work, but never solve hard problems alone

  • Regular offsites with the greatest team: think Austrian mountains, lakeside retreats or European cities

You will help us build, operate and industrialize the storage foundation of our on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, experienced team, you will own the Ceph clusters behind our block, object and file storage services – essentially the storage every customer workload eventually lands on. The platform is still actively being built, which means you will have real influence on the storage architecture, hardware lifecycle, automation strategy and technical direction. The role goes beyond Ceph itself: you will regularly work across bare metal, networking, OpenStack, Kubernetes and GitOps. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and help make storage predictable, durable and highly automated as we scale into the petabytes

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

· Ceph · OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go · Cinder ·Neutron · Nova · RBD · Cilium
· RGW/ S3 · Prometheus/ Grafana · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, operate and evolve our Ceph clusters for block, object / S3 and file storage - from CRUSH topology and failure domains to pool design, placement groups, erasure coding, capacity headroom and performance.

  • Own the storage hardware lifecycle end to end – from qualification and burn-in through firmware, controller and disk health to OSD add/drain/replace, node retirement and hardware refresh. A key part of the job is automating these processes without creating tenant-visible impact.

  • Automate the provisioning of storage nodes on OpenStack-managed bare metal, working with Ironic, RAID and disk configuration, SEDs, provider networks and VLANs. You will also own the artefact path around images, package mirrors, certificates and other dependencies needed to bring up clusters in environments with tightly controlled external connectivity.

  • Run upgrades, rebalancing and reconfigurations as routine production operations, evolve our Infrastructure as Code and GitOps setup with Ansible, Terraform and FluxCD / ArgoCD, and make sure storage integrates cleanly with both OpenStack and Kubernetes.

  • Own capacity planning and growth forecasting, use telemetry to understand real consumption, and build out monitoring, testing and failure-injection around performance, durability and security.

  • AI-assisted engineering is simply part of how we work today. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they genuinely help – across development, testing, reviews, incident triage, knowledge retrieval or automation - and help us push further into self-healing and auto-remediation.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner across Ceph, storage, automation and AI tooling, document technical decisions and share your knowledge with the team.

What we offer

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages


  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Storage Engineer or Platform Engineer running production storage infrastructure, with solid experience deploying, operating and debugging Ceph in production.

  • You know the Ceph fundamentals from real-world operations: CRUSH, pools and placement groups, replication vs. erasure coding, BlueStore, scrubbing, recovery and backfill under load.

  • You have managed storage infrastructure end to end, from the physical layer with drives, firmware, BIOS, controllers and hardware diagnostics through rebalancing, host drains, capacity expansion and hardware generation migrations.

  • You are comfortable using Kubernetes as a control plane, not only as a workload runtime, and understand operators/controllers, custom resources, reconciliation and GitOps. You can also move confidently around OpenStack and debug issues involving Ironic, Neutron, Nova or Glance when needed.

  • You have dealt with situations where durability really matters – such as degraded or near-full clusters, recovery under load or split-brain conditions – and you are used to making changes in a staged, evidence-based and reversible way.

  • You have strong Linux and bare-metal skills, understand the block layer, filesystems and I/O behaviour, and are comfortable working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your day-to-day work. You have practical experience with LLMs and agentic tools and know where they can meaningfully support development, testing, reviews or operations.

  • Ideally, you also bring experience with RGW / S3, RBD mirroring, CephFS or ceph-csi, deeper OpenStack storage integrations and Go and/or Python. Experience around VLAN/BGP, storage performance tuning, NVMe/BlueStore, observability, data protection, encryption, auto-remediation, security baselines or multi-site storage is also relevant for the role.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership, and are comfortable debugging problems where the actual root cause may sit somewhere between storage, networking, Kubernetes and OpenStack. You would rather verify what is happening from evidence than assume how the system should behave.

  • We work in an international environment in English, so you should feel comfortable discussing technical topics, documenting decisions and working with the team in English.

Du gewinnst neue Talente, begleitest Mitarbeitende über den gesamten Beschäftigungszeitraum und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei anspruchsvollen Personalentscheidungen. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du HR-Prozesse und setzt Projekte eigenständig um.
Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in unserem Hamburger Office. Zweimal im Monat bist du vor Ort in Lensahn. Du bist Teil unseres HR-Teams und arbeitest eng mit unserer Head of HR, dem COO und unserem Head of Logistics zusammen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Recruiting ganzheitlich verantworten: Du steuerst die Personalgewinnung für Lensahn – von der vorausschauenden Bedarfsplanung über Stellenausschreibungen, aktive Kandidatenansprache und Interviews bis zur Einstellung.
  • Neue Recruiting-Wege erschließen: Du findest geeignete Kanäle für die Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender, setzt neue Maßnahmen um und entwickelst eine verlässliche Bewerberpipeline. Dabei behältst du Bewerberqualität und Besetzungsgeschwindigkeit im Blick.
  • Führungskräfte als Sparringspartner unterstützen: Du erkennst personellen Handlungsbedarf frühzeitig, gibst klare Empfehlungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit COO und Head of Logistics pragmatische Lösungen für den Lageralltag.
  • Employee Relations aktiv gestalten: Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte, klärst Personalfragen und begleitest auch anspruchsvolle Gespräche und Konfliktsituationen souverän.
  • Arbeitsrechtliche Personalthemen steuern: Du ordnest Sachverhalte ein, bereitest erforderliche Maßnahmen vor und setzt sie in Abstimmung mit der Head of HR um. Dazu gehören Veränderungen im Arbeitsverhältnis, der Umgang mit Pflichtverletzungen und die professionelle Begleitung von Trennungsprozessen.
  • Verträge und Fristen im Griff behalten: Du erstellst und koordinierst Arbeitsverträge, Verlängerungen, Zusatzvereinbarungen und weitere Personaldokumente. Du sorgst dafür, dass anstehende Entscheidungen frühzeitig vorbereitet und relevante Fristen eingehalten werden.
  • Personio und digitale Personalakten aufbauen: Du strukturierst die Personalverwaltung für Lensahn in Personio, sorgst für vollständige Unterlagen und aktuelle Stammdaten und etablierst verlässliche digitale Abläufe.
  • HR-Projekte vorantreiben: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und verantwortest größere standortbezogene Projekte – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. Dazu gehören beispielsweise ein strukturiertes Onboarding, die Digitalisierung von Personalprozessen und einheitliche Standards für die Zusammenarbeit zwischen HR und Logistik.
  • Den gesamten Mitarbeiterzyklus begleiten: Du stellst sicher, dass vom Eintritt bis zum Austritt alle personellen und administrativen Schritte ineinandergreifen und das Offboarding vollständig abgeschlossen wird.


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung im operativen HR-Management mit eigenständiger Verantwortung für Recruiting, Personalbetreuung und arbeitsrechtliche Themen.
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement, Wirtschaftsrecht, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung.
  • Nachweisbare Recruiting-Erfolge, idealerweise bei der Gewinnung gewerblicher Mitarbeitender in Logistik, Lager, Produktion oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und praktische Erfahrung mit anspruchsvollen Personalfällen. Du kannst Handlungsmöglichkeiten bewerten und erkennst, wann eine zusätzliche rechtliche Prüfung erforderlich ist.
  • Erfahrung darin, Führungskräfte zu beraten, klare Empfehlungen auszusprechen und schwierige Personalgespräche professionell zu führen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Umsetzung von HR-Projekten und im Aufbau funktionierender Personalprozesse.
  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Personio oder einem vergleichbaren HR-System sowie hohe Sorgfalt bei Verträgen, Daten und Dokumentation.

  • Die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung bis ins operative Detail zu übernehmen – vom Recruiting-Konzept bis zur vollständigen Personalakte.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie die Bereitschaft, zweimal im Monat unseren Standort in Lensahn zu besuchen.


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Ein eigener Verantwortungsbereich: Du gestaltest die Personalarbeit für unseren Lagerstandort und beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie das Team wächst und zusammenarbeitet.
  • Eine Rolle mit Substanz: Du verbindest Recruiting, Employee Relations, Arbeitsrecht und HR-Projekte und begleitest Themen von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

title: Senior Funnel Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Die meisten Copywriter schreiben Sätze, die gut klingen. Wir suchen jemanden, der Sätze schreibt, die verkaufen.

Wenn du eine Anzeige liest und sofort siehst, welcher Hook zieht, welcher Angle trägt und wo der Leser aussteigt, bevor er kauft — dann lies weiter. Wenn dir "kreativ schreiben" nicht reicht und du wissen willst, warum ein Satz konvertiert und der andere nicht — dann erst recht.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über eine Million Kund:innen gewachsen und wurde von Financial Times und Statista als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas ausgezeichnet. Mit einem über 150-köpfigen Team an unseren Standorten Hamburg und Kiel sowie einem eigenen rund 22.000 m² großen Logistikzentrum in Lensahn bauen wir die führende Footwear- und Fashion-Brand Europas weiter aus.

Unser klares Ziel: von aktuell mittleren achtstelligen auf neunstellige Jahresumsätze zu skalieren. Damit das gelingt, müssen wir immer neue Menschen erreichen, ihr Vertrauen gewinnen und sie vom Kauf überzeugen — auf Wegen, die wir bisher noch nicht gegangen sind.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Funnel Specialist (m/w/d), der bzw. die die komplette Funnel-Journey von der ersten Anzeige bis zum Kaufabschluss textlich verantwortet.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du schreibst Werbeanzeigen, Produkttexte und Website-Copy entlang der gesamten Journey: Werbeanzeige → Produktseite → Kauf
  • Du denkst Performance Marketing als Psychologie – du überzeugst emotional UND rational, nicht "wie im Retail"
  • Du baust mit deinen Texten Autorität und Vertrauen auf (Social Proof, ggf. Referenzen bekannter Stimmen der Branche)
  • Du entwickelst mit uns neue Content-Funnel-Formate, die wir bisher noch nicht genutzt haben: Advertorials, Listicles und Native Ads (z. B. über Online-Magazine) – mit Call-to-Action nach einem informierenden Beitrag statt klassischer Anzeige
  • Du erzählst ein relatable Storytelling rund um unseren USP
  • Du sorgst mit Vertrauenselementen (z. B. Klarna, PayPal) auf unserer Website dafür, dass Kaufbarrieren fallen
  • Du versetzt dich tief in die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppe hinein und schreibst konsequent in unserer Markenstimme
  • Du musst Media Buying nicht selbst operativ umsetzen – aber du verstehst, wie Facebook Ads grundsätzlich funktionieren, und denkst wie jemand, der selbst kaufen würde


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst ca. 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Copywriter im Marketing mit (Produkttexte, Website-Texte o. Ä.)
  • Du hast ausgezeichnete Deutsch- UND Englischkenntnisse
  • Du hast bereits als Creative Strategist, Media Buyer oder Copywriter gearbeitet (oder eine Kombination daraus)
  • Du recherchierst gründlich, schreibst kreativ und verstehst die Psychologie hinter einer Kaufentscheidung
  • Du hast ein Grundverständnis von Media Buying / wie Facebook Ads funktionieren
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits in Branchen mit starker Direct-Response-Tradition getextet
  • Du bringst solide EDV-Kenntnisse mit
  • Deiner Bewerbung fügst du eine Arbeitsprobe bzw. ein Portfolio bei (z. B. Listicles, eigene Werbetexte) – deine Texte sagen uns mehr als dein Lebenslauf


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Echte Karriereperspektiven – wachse mit uns in die Rolle, die zu dir passt
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich deinem Leben anpassen
  • Großzügiges Weiterbildungsbudget für deine persönliche Entwicklung
  • Eine Kultur, in der deine Meinung zählt und Wertschätzung gelebt wird
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, keine endlosen Meetings

We are Laminar Projects!

It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 
 
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
 
Core values for a good life
 
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
 
- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 
- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 
- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team

We enshrined our values in our vision:
 
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
 
- Connects us with meaningful relationships 
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans

By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
 
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
 
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society
____________________________________________________________
The Role 
 
Purpose of the role
 
You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general.
 
Your Team
 
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on:
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are

- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
____________________________________________________________
Frequently Asked Questions 
 
What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally.

One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. title: Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)

Regional Role · Remote, based in the DACH region · Reports to: Sales Director

About Everfield

Everfield acquires and builds vertical SaaS businesses across Europe. Our portfolio spans more than 40 companies serving niche markets where software is mission-critical. We take a long-term ownership approach: we buy, invest, and build. We don't flip. Seven companies are in DACH, and we expect continuous growth in portfolio size and performance across all regions.

We are building a small, high-impact HQ revenue team responsible for lifting the commercial capability of our portfolio companies: setting standards, identifying risk, and accelerating performance. The role reports to Everfield's Sales Director, who owns consistency of the revenue system across all regions, and works day to day with the region's General Director and the CEOs of its Business Units.

The Opportunity

The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region.

This is not purely an advisory role. Alongside the regional remit, the RSM is expected to take direct sales management responsibility inside Business Units where that is the fastest route to growth, giving smaller commercial teams access to experienced sales leadership they would not otherwise have. As the region scales, the ambition is that one person can hold the sales management role on behalf of several Business Units at once, applying a standard across all of them.

Success is reflected in improved revenue predictability, stronger pipeline discipline, and sustained bookings growth across Business Units.

How the Role Operates

• Two levels, one standard. The regional remit is constant: diagnostics, pipeline discipline, forecast integrity, and commercial governance across every Business Unit in the cluster. Beyond it, the role flexes. In some Business Units you will coach and support an existing sales manager. In others you will hold the sales management role yourself.

• Direct team leadership where it is needed. Where you act as sales manager, you own the team, the pipeline, the forecast, and the number, in the same way a local sales manager would, and you report into that Business Unit's CEO for delivery while remaining accountable to Everfield for how the work is done.

• You are not a seller. You do not carry a personal quota and you are not measured on deals you close yourself. You are measured on what the teams you lead and support deliver.

• Reporting. You report to Everfield's Sales Director for standards, priorities, and development. The role is a shared resource for the region rather than a function serving any single Business Unit, acting in close partnership with Group Directors, CEOs, and sales teams.

What You Will Do

Sales Execution & Commercial Acceleration

• Drive new and expansion bookings growth across the cluster, with consistent attention to prospecting, opportunity development, and account growth.

• Act as sales manager for one or more Business Units: run the weekly rhythm, set priorities, coach the team, and hold sellers to their number.

• Reduce volatility in bookings performance and increase revenue consistency across the cluster.

• Strengthen proactive sales behaviour across outbound, account expansion, renewals and opportunity reactivation.

• Improve sales execution across the full funnel, from lead generation through to closing and account retention.

• Embed sales methodology and qualification standards, and hold teams to them through evidence rather than instruction.

• Lead deal/pipeline reviews and targeted coaching to improve win rates, shorten cycle times, and build seller capability.

Pipeline Discipline & Forecast Integrity

• Improve forecast reliability across Business Units, working toward 5% variance or better.

• Define and apply opportunity qualification standards and run structured pipeline reviews.

• Ensure pipeline visibility reflects realistic execution capacity, and raise revenue risks early to Business Units and Everfield leadership, always paired with a recommended course of action rather than an open flag.

• Monitor sustained underperformance patterns and ensure corrective action plans are implemented in time to matter.

Revenue Standards & Definitions

• Act as guardian of Everfield's revenue definitions in the region: what counts as a booking, how new name is separated from back to base, how recurring value is recognised, and what enters the pipeline in the first place.

• Hold those definitions consistently, including where a Business Unit's own commercial logic pushes against them, and fix the incentive, target, or CRM design underneath rather than bending the measurement.

• Make the cluster comparable to every other region, so performance can be read the same way across the portfolio.

Commercial Governance

• Ensure transparency in quota design, attainment measurement, and sales capacity planning.

• Support commission structure alignment with business goals.

• Contribute to annual, quarterly, and monthly commercial planning by reality-checking growth assumptions against pipeline health, execution capacity, and historical feasibility.

Commercial Diagnostics

• Diagnose revenue performance across segments, teams, and funnel stages, identifying where revenue is generated, stalled, or lost.

• Produce a written diagnostic and prioritised action plan for each Business Unit you take on, naming the problem, the cause, the cost of inaction, the action, the owner, and the date.

• Prioritise your own time across the cluster on distance to target, materiality to the region, and whether a documented plan already exists.

• Provide feedback on pricing discipline, discounting practices, packaging effectiveness, and ICP conversion efficiency.

• Translate performance signals into executive-level recommendations and commercial action plans.

CEO & General Director Partnership

• Act as strategic commercial partner to CEOs and Business Unit leaders, representing Everfield's revenue expectations and performance discipline.

• Challenge growth assumptions constructively and escalate persistent underperformance when required.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 12 months:

• Full visibility into the commercial funnel, aligned with HQ reporting standards.

• Acceleration of organic recurring revenue growth across the region.

• Improved reliability of pipeline data and forecast accuracy.

• Sales pipelines that more accurately predict bookings performance.

• At least one Business Unit where you hold sales management directly and the team delivers against its number.

• Reliable visibility of quota attainment and seller productivity.

• Deal reviews embedded across portfolio sales teams, resulting in higher win rates and shorter sales cycles.

• Revenue per seller increasing steadily across the cluster.

• A documented, reusable set of playbooks and diagnostics that other regions can apply without starting again.

What We Are Looking For

• 6-10 years total experience in B2B SaaS revenue roles, with at least 3-4 years in a sales management position, accountable for a team's bookings performance and not only for personal pipeline contribution.

• Track record of consistent revenue target attainment in a management role. You have owned a number and delivered against it, not only improved process quality.

• Direct experience leading and developing a sales team, including hiring, coaching, and managing underperformance. You will do this again here, inside our Business Units.

• Track record of implementing structured pipeline management: defining stage criteria, enforcing qualification standards, running deal reviews, and improving forecast reliability.

• Experience diagnosing revenue performance across the full funnel: understanding where deals are lost, why cycles extend, and what structural issues limit growth.

• Manages through CRM data: uses pipeline data to run structured deal reviews, identify risk, and hold sellers accountable to data quality. Familiar with Salesforce or HubSpot as a management tool.

• Experience working with senior stakeholders (CEOs, founders, or general managers) on commercial performance, including navigating organisational resistance and earning trust before driving change.

• Experience adapting sales management approach across companies at different sales maturity levels: able to calibrate coaching, process rigour, and expectations to fit the context.

• German fluency required, with professional English for work across the group. European B2B SaaS market experience required.

• Commercial finance literacy is a strong advantage: reading a P&L, understanding revenue recognition, and being able to argue the return on a commercial investment.

• Private-equity-backed or multi-entity SaaS environment experience is a strong advantage.

Skills

• Structured coaching and seller development: designing and running structured 1:1s, deal reviews, and field accompaniment to build individual seller capability, not just inspect opportunities.

• Pipeline discipline and forecasting: reading a pipeline critically, identifying risk early, and improving forecast reliability.

• Change management: driving commercial process adoption across multiple teams, and building momentum without relying on formal authority.

• Documentation and knowledge scale: writing down what you diagnose and what you implement, in a form another person can pick up and run. Work that lives only in conversation does not scale across a portfolio, and anything you build for one Business Unit should be reusable in the next.

• Commercial planning and challenge: building a bottom-up view of what revenue targets are achievable, pressure-testing top-down assumptions, and presenting credible alternatives to leadership.

• Commercial storytelling: presenting clear, honest risk assessments to CEOs and senior leadership, and leading a review that drives decisions rather than just restating numbers.

  • Full Business proficiency in German and English is a must

Who You Are

• You lead teams and you influence without authority. You will manage sellers directly in some Business Units and hold no formal authority in others. Both need to work. You build trust quickly and drive change through credibility, clarity, and structured analysis.

• You are hands-on with sales execution. You are comfortable stepping into real deals, reviewing opportunities with sellers, and diagnosing pipeline issues directly with the team, without needing to be the person closing.

• You combine analytical thinking with practical commercial judgement. You interpret pipeline data, and you also understand the realities of getting deals done.

• You communicate clearly and directly. You raise commercial risks early, with a recommendation attached, and challenge assumptions constructively, including when performance doesn't meet expectations.

You are pragmatic in complex environments. Portfolio companies vary in maturity and commercial model. You bring discipline without imposing rigid process that doesn't fit the situation

title: Founding Technical Project Manager
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

On our largest global rollouts, connectivity is what makes or breaks the program.

These customers run several ERP systems across many entities and countries, with interfaces, master data and process variants that have grown over decades. Whether blp is usable on day one, and whether the first go-live holds its date, depends more on getting that landscape right than on almost anything else. You are the person who makes sure it is right. You sit opposite the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, understand what their landscape actually does rather than what the documentation says, and shape the technical solution with them.

Getting this right is relentless project management as much as architecture. Requirements on a landscape this size never arrive clear. You chase them until they are: pushing the customer's IT organization for answers, going back when an answer is vague, and refusing to let an assumption stand in for a decision. You spot the major developments and the roadblocks early, while there is still time to do something about them, and you put them in front of the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee rather than discovering them in test.

When you raise something, you bring the way through it. You prepare the discussion with the customer, make the implications clear in their language, and come with options. "We cannot do that and we will miss the go-live" is not the job. Working out what would make it possible, and what it costs, is. Where something exceeds the standard you prepare the decision rather than take it alone: options, effort, consequences, and a clear recommendation for the steering committee or for our engineering leadership.

You are the strong technical counterpart for the customer's IT organization and for the Senior Project Manager. Both rely on you to know what is actually true. You work primarily up to the first go-live, where the solution design is either right or expensive, and you are staffed by process and landscape complexity rather than by deal size.

A word on what you build. Our integration layer works like an iPaaS: connections are assembled as configuration on our own platform, specific to that customer, rather than written as code. You work in that layer yourself, so this is a hands-on role, and you document what you have configured so that the next person can understand and maintain it. What you do not do is write code that ships with the product. That distinction is what keeps a customer-specific solution from quietly becoming everyone's problem.

Two roles sit either side of you and the handoffs are clean.

With the Integrations Engineer: you define what the connection has to do and why, they build and operate it at that customer and own whether it runs. You hand them a specification, they come back with questions and constraints from the real system, and you resolve them together. When something breaks in their environment, it is theirs. When something is wrong in what was asked for, it is yours.

With the Product Engineer: when a requirement cannot be met in configuration, or when the same requirement has now appeared at the third customer, you make the case for building it into the product. You write the specification, they build it, and you are the one who confirms it actually solves the customer problem it came from. After that it is part of the standard and you configure against it like anything else.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the technical solution with the customer, including their enterprise architects and IT leads.

  • Turn business requirements into a clear, implementable specification.

  • Drive requirements to clarity, relentlessly. Chase the customer's IT organization until an answer is specific enough to build on.

  • Configure integrations on our platform where the standard covers it, and document what you have configured.

  • Identify precisely where the standard does not cover a requirement, and judge whether it belongs in configuration or in the product.

  • Identify major development needs and technical roadblocks early, and escalate them to the Senior Project Manager and into the steering committee while there is still time.

  • Prepare those discussions with the customer: make the implications clear, and bring options rather than a refusal.

  • Prepare scope decisions with options, effort and consequences, and bring a clear recommendation to the steering committee or to our engineering leadership.

  • Specify what the Integrations Engineer builds at the customer, and resolve the constraints they bring back from the real system.

  • Make the case for what should be built once for everyone, hand it to our Product Engineers with a proper specification, and confirm it solves the problem it came from.

  • Support the Senior Project Manager and Project Manager on technical feasibility, effort and sequencing.

  • Stay on the account through the first go-live, and hand over a solution design that is documented and maintainable.

  • Feed recurring customer requirements back to Product so the standard grows in the right direction.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Relentless on Clarity – You do not accept a vague answer as an answer, and you keep going until the requirement is specific enough to build on.

  • Architectural Judgment – You can tell the difference between a requirement that deserves a custom solution and one that deserves a conversation.

  • Credibility with Architects – You hold your own with a customer's enterprise architect and earn their trust rather than deferring to them.

  • Clear Recommendations – You frame a difficult scope question so that the people who decide can actually decide, and you say plainly what you would do.

  • Translation – You move between a business requirement and a technical design in both directions without losing anything.

  • Long-Term Thinking – You design for what the customer will need in two years, not only for what unblocks the current wave.

What You Bring

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in solution design, technical consulting, enterprise integration or a technical product role.

  • Solid understanding of enterprise system landscapes: ERP systems, interfaces, master data, and how data actually moves between them.

  • Hands-on experience configuring integrations on an integration platform, or comparable low-code or configuration-driven work.

  • Experience writing specifications that engineers can build from without a translation layer.

  • Track record of driving technical clarity in a project setting, including escalating early and constructively.

  • Comfortable in customer-facing technical discussions with senior IT stakeholders.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for hands-on experience with SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or comparable ERP systems, or with e-invoicing and EDI standards.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

title: Werkstudent KI & Automatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Hi, ich bin Felix Lippe.

Vor ein paar Jahren habe ich Lippe Personal gegründet. Heute sind wir über 25 Leute und eine der führenden Recruiting-Agenturen für medizinische Praxen in Deutschland: Ärzte, Zahnärzte, Physiotherapeuten, Pflege. Wir haben in den letzten Jahren hunderte Praxen betreut und tausende Bewerbungen für unsere Kunden generiert. Das Geschäft läuft.

Und jetzt kommt der Teil, warum ich diese Stelle ausschreibe.

Ich baue das Unternehmen gerade grundlegend um: weg von manueller Arbeit, hin zu einem KI-gesteuerten Unternehmen. Nicht als Buzzword auf der Website, sondern als echtes Projekt, an dem ich täglich selbst arbeite – mit Tools wie Claude Code, n8n und einem eigenen KI-Setup. Ich tausche mich dazu laufend mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten aus, ich stecke tief im Thema. Was mir fehlt, ist nicht das Wissen und sind nicht die Ideen. Was mir fehlt, ist Zeit und eine rechte Hand, die mit mir baut.

Genau das ist diese Stelle.

Die Rolle: Werkstudent mit Founder-Associate-Charakter

Du arbeitest nicht „bei uns in der IT". Du arbeitest mit mir. Direkt, auf Geschäftsführer-Ebene, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen.

Konkret heißt das: Wir schauen uns gemeinsam an, wo im Unternehmen noch manuell gearbeitet wird, und dann bauen wir das weg. Du bekommst von mir klare Briefings, setzt eigenständig um, und wir sprechen uns in einem festen wöchentlichen Termin ab – oft auch öfter, weil ich Sparring liebe. Du bist bei strategischen Themen dabei, verstehst, warum wir Dinge tun, und siehst, wie ein Unternehmen von innen umgebaut wird. Wenn ich mich mit externen KI-Agenturen und Experten austausche, bekommst du das mit und lernst direkt daraus – genau wie ich.

Das ist der Deal: Du hebelst meine Zeit, ich gebe dir Einblicke und Verantwortung, die du als Werkstudent sonst nirgendwo bekommst.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust mit KI-Tools (vor allem Claude Code) Automatisierungen für unser Tagesgeschäft: Bewerbermanagement, Reporting, Anzeigenerstellung

  • Du optimierst, automatisierst und digitalisierst Prozesse quer durchs Unternehmen – vom Vertrieb bis zum Fulfillment

  • Du setzt Workflows in n8n auf und verbindest unsere Tools miteinander (Airtable, HubSpot, GitHub)

  • Du dokumentierst, was du baust, so dass es als System im Unternehmen bleibt und wächst

  • Du bist mein Sparringspartner: Wir entwickeln gemeinsam weiter, wie dieses Unternehmen in zwei Jahren arbeitet

Was ich dir biete

  • 20 Euro pro Stunde – bewusst am oberen Ende für Werkstudenten in Düsseldorf, weil ich lieber einen richtig Guten habe als drei Mittelmäßige

  • 16 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, flexibel um deinen Vorlesungsplan herum, in den Semesterferien gerne mehr

  • Nach der Einarbeitung weitgehend Homeoffice. Unser Office in Düsseldorf steht dir jederzeit offen

  • Professionelles KI-Setup ab Tag eins (u. a. Claude Code Max Plan) – du arbeitest mit Tools, die die meisten Unternehmen noch nicht mal kennen

  • Direkter Zugang zu allem, was ich lerne: aus dem Austausch mit KI-Agenturen, Experten und aus unseren eigenen Projekten

  • Echte Verantwortung statt Praktikanten-Aufgaben: Was du baust, läuft danach jeden Tag in einem echten Unternehmen

  • Eine Erfahrung, die dich von praktisch jedem Absolventen abhebt: Du hast nicht über digitale Transformation gelesen, du hast eine mitgebaut

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

Bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben, das liest hier keiner. Stattdessen:

  1. Bewerbung über das Formular – Lebenslauf plus (das ist mir am wichtigsten) ein Link zu irgendetwas, das du gebaut hast: GitHub-Repo, kleines Tool, Automatisierung, Uni-Projekt. Größe egal. Dazu zwei, drei Sätze, was du zuletzt mit KI gelöst hast

  2. Probeaufgabe – wenn deine Bewerbung passt, bekommst du eine kleine Aufgabe (zwei bis drei Stunden Aufwand)

  3. 30-Minuten-Call mit mir – wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen

  4. Entscheidung innerhalb von 48 Stunden. Versprochen

Ich freue mich auf dich.

Felix Lippe
Geschäftsführer, Lippe Personal GmbH


Dein Profil

Ich halte das bewusst offen, weil mir deine Denkweise wichtiger ist als dein Lebenslauf:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Vollzeit-Student, zum Beispiel in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science oder etwas Vergleichbarem. Auch andere Studiengänge sind okay, wenn du technisch unterwegs bist

  • Du hast schon mal mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code, Cursor oder ChatGPT etwas Eigenes gebaut oder automatisiert. Muss nichts Großes sein, aber du solltest es zeigen können

  • Begriffe wie Git und Terminal schrecken dich nicht ab

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch: Du fragst nicht „was soll ich tun?", sondern „was bringt uns weiter?"

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig und brauchst niemanden, der dir dreimal am Tag über die Schulter schaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift

Falls du denkst „ich habe noch nie professionell programmiert": völlig okay. Ich suche keinen fertigen Entwickler. Ich suche jemanden, der mit KI-Tools umgehen kann, Prozesse versteht und Lust hat, mit einem Gründer ein Unternehmen umzubauen. Das ist ein eigenes Handwerk – und ehrlich gesagt eines der wertvollsten, die man 2026 lernen kann.

description:
Wir öffnen eine neue, zentrale Position in unserem Team: eine Person, die Recruiting nicht als Aufgabe, sondern als Handwerk und Hebel für Unternehmenserfolg versteht. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Besetzung von Rollen über alle Funktionen und Senioritätsstufen hinweg – von Fachexpert:innen bis Führungspositionen – und gestaltest gleichzeitig aktiv mit, wie Talent Acquisition bei uns strukturell und strategisch weiterwächst.

Wir suchen jemanden, der im Recruiting bereits angekommen ist - mit fundierter Praxis, einem klaren Verständnis für die Mechanik guter Prozesse und dem Ehrgeiz, den Bereich aktiv mitzuprägen. Du bewegst dich souverän zwischen operativer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick, zwischen Tempo und Präzision, zwischen Beratung und klarer Kante gegenüber Stakeholdern bis auf C-Level.

Recruiting bei uns ist kein ruhiges Gewässer. Es ist schnell, anspruchsvoll und ergebnisorientiert. Genau das soll dich reizen, nicht abschrecken.

Was du bewegst

Operative Verantwortung

  • End-to-End-Ownership vielfältiger Recruiting-Prozesse – unterschiedliche Funktionen, unterschiedliche Level, unterschiedliche Herausforderungen

  • Sparringspartner:in für Hiring Manager, Leadership und C-Level – von der Anforderungsschärfung bis zur finalen Entscheidung

  • Strukturierte, kompetenzbasierte Interviewführung mit hohem Anspruch an Qualität und Fairness

  • Aktive Marktbearbeitung durch gezieltes Sourcing

  • Eine Candidate Experience, die auch unter Zeitdruck überzeugt

Strategisches Ownership

  • Mitgestaltung des Talent-Acquisition-Bereichs in enger Abstimmung mit dem Head of - strukturell, prozessual, strategisch

  • Volle Verantwortung für den Recruiting-Funnel: Kennzahlen definieren, Conversion steigern, Engpässe erkennen, konsequent nachschärfen

  • Aufbau strategischer Talent Pools für Profile, die immer wieder gefragt sind

  • Entwicklung von Active-Search-Strategien

  • Verantwortung für Recruiting-Tools und -Systeme - von Auswahl bis Optimierung

  • Aufbau externer Partnerschaften, die unser Recruiting schlagkräftiger machen


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Praktische Recruiting-Erfahrung, im Idealfall bereits über mehrere Funktionen und Senioritäten hinweg

  • Ein geschärftes Verständnis für strukturierte, datenbasierte Recruiting-Prozesse und Active Sourcing

  • Souveränität und Verhandlungsgeschick im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Stakeholdern bis in die Geschäftsführung

  • Die Fähigkeit, gleichzeitig operativ tief einzusteigen und strategisch den Überblick zu behalten

  • Belastbarkeit und einen kühlen Kopf, wenn mehrere kritische Suchen parallel unter Druck stehen

  • Ein analytischer Blick auf Funnel, Kennzahlen und Prozessqualität

  • Verbindlichkeit, Beratungsstärke und den Mut, auch unbequeme Empfehlungen auszusprechen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

 

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division. 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries.
  • Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.
  • Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have)

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.
  • Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

  • Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets.
  • Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

  • Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions.
  • Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Nice to have

  • Experience with hybrid frameworks/platforms (Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile, React Native) and understanding their architecture.
  • Experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, and integrating backend services.
  • Experience in UI/UX design or a good eye for design principles and user interface consistency.

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Sales Development Senior Manager to join our Sales team in Berlin! 

This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Act as the direct leader and mentor for our front-line Business Development Representative (BDR) team, fostering a culture of growth and purpose.
  • Conduct live call-shadowing and deep-dive reviews to sharpen your team's ability to communicate the transformative power of Wellhub.
  • Take full accountability for a team of 5–8 BDRs, guiding their professional journey and ensuring they hit the milestones that drive our mission forward.
  • Lead the interview process for new talent and execute a seamless onboarding program that gets new starters hitting "active" status within 30 days.
  • Excellence in building strong partnerships with marketing and sales.
  • Deeply understand the UK B2B ecosystem to teach your team how to position wellbeing as a "business-critical" priority for CHROs and CFOs.
  • Pivot messaging based on market shifts to ensure Wellhub remains a vital solution for companies navigating industry headwinds.
  • Manage the "speed-to-lead" for inbound inquiries, ensuring high conversion rates through rigorous qualification.
  • Work with the team to build hyper-personalised outbound "clusters." You'll move beyond generic sequences to high-intent, research-backed prospecting.
  • Ensure the team is getting maximum ROI out of Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and AI-assisted prospecting tools.
  • Develop the best-in-class strategies for managing the rep's book of business and running the outreach-prospecting playbook and turning curiosity into attention with intention.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven Track Record: 5+ years in Sales, with at least 1-2 years of experience as a Lead BDR or Front-line Manager.
  • The "Coach" DNA: A passion for seeing others succeed.
  • You can look at a conversion funnel and pinpoint exactly where the "leak" is-whether it's the initial hook, the discovery call, or the hand-off to the AE.
  • Proven experience managing SDR/BDR teams for a Challenger Brand or a "non-commodity" solution.
  • You must demonstrate the ability to create urgency for a product that is not yet a "household name" or is perceived as discretionary spend.
  • You have moved beyond "feature-selling" and can coach reps to pivot from Product Interest to Business Impact.
  • You should be able to show how you've successfully positioned a solution as "mission-critical" during budget-conscious cycles.
  • You are familiar with the HR space and can talk the CHRO language.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. 

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. 

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role is Hybrid, with a minimum of 2 days per week in-office. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

  • Germany-based and fully work-authorized, with a feasible client migration path within approximately six months and no restrictive non-competes.

This is a hybrid role based in Berlin, Germany.

title: Langfuse - Product Engineer, Integrations
description:
Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse

Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands.

Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations.

You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development.

The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

Everything you build is open source and immediately visible.

All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain framework integrations. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it.

  • Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. You’ll develop strong opinions on what makes a great integration experience.

  • Contribute to the core SDKs. While integrations are your primary focus, your work will surface needs in our Python and TypeScript SDKs. You’ll contribute improvements to the core SDK when your integration work demands it — whether that’s a new hook point, better context propagation, or performance optimizations.

  • Write documentation and integration guides. At Langfuse, docs are part of our core product. When you ship a new integration, the guide ships with it. You’ll own the integration docs, quickstart tutorials, cookbooks, and migration paths that help developers get started in minutes.

  • Be a voice in the developer community. You’ll engage with framework communities, respond to integration-related GitHub issues, write blog posts about new integrations, and be present in our Slack/Discord channels. You’ll build relationships with framework maintainers and represent Langfuse in the broader AI developer ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • Passionate about the LLM ecosystem. You’ve built real applications with frameworks like LangChain, Pydantic AI, Vercel AI SDK, LlamaIndex, or similar — or you have a deep willingness to go deep and get your hands dirty with every major framework in the space. You’re excited about this ecosystem, not just familiar with it.

  • Strong in Python and/or TypeScript. You write clean, reliable code. You don’t need to be a systems-level performance expert, but you care about code quality and understand that integrations run inside other people’s production systems.

  • Product-minded engineer. You think about the developer who’s going to use your integration at 11pm trying to ship a feature. You obsess over the getting-started experience: how many lines of code does it take? Is the error message helpful? Does the docs example actually work?
